caption: The drawing depicts a wooden armoire or cabinet with two doors open, revealing its interior layout. The main structure is colored in varying shades of brown to represent wood grain, with darker hues on the doors and some surfaces, and lighter browns used for shelves and drawer fronts. The left side of the cabinet contains several horizontal compartments or shelves stacked one above the other, while the right side features a single large vertical space with no shelves. Below the shelves, there are three drawers, each with two small round metallic handles colored in brass or gold. The cabinet is supported by four carved, spindle-like legs. At the bottom of the drawing, outside the cabinet, are two small pencil sketches: on the left, a detailed drawing labeled "HANDLE," which appears to be a lion’s head design for a handle or pull; on the right, a rough perspective sketch of the cabinet's interior structure. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white. The drawing is signed “Edna Ray” in the lower right corner.
title: Wardrobe, John Marshall's
